crossRefs.note: There was a man in the land of Uz, whose name was Job. That man was blameless and upright, and one who feared God, and…
and all the mixed people, and all the kings of the land of Uz, all the kings of the Philistines, Ashkelon, Gaza, Ekron…
Rejoice and be glad, daughter of Edom, that dwells in the land of Uz. The cup will pass through to you also. You will…

parallels.note: The sons of Ezer: Bilhan, Zaavan, and Jaakan. The sons of Dishan: Uz and Aran.

people.name: Aran
people.line: Son of Dishan, descendant of Seir the Horite

people.name: Uz
people.line: Son of Dishan, a Horite chief

translations.web: These are the children of Dishan: Uz and Aran.
